## ObjectReference interface

A reference to exactly one object.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ObjectReference<T, R extends string = string> extends Resolvable<T>
```

**Extends:** [Resolvable](./contracts.resolvable.md)<!-- -->&lt;T&gt;

## Remarks

Resolving yields the object's record, or fails with a target-not-found error if nothing matches. Duplicate-name behavior is app-defined.
